He smiled, tucking the note into his thick wool coat pocket, already planning his reply over warm oat porridge back in the lighthouse cottage.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还浸在灰蓝色的薄雾里，鳞次栉比的楼宇熄了大半灯火，只有街灯拖着暖黄的光晕，在空荡的柏油路上拉出长长的影子。环卫工的竹扫帚擦过路面，发出细碎的沙沙声，巷口24小时便利店的玻璃门透出冷白的光，偶有晚归的人拖着疲惫的脚步走过。风裹着夜的凉意扫过街角，半开的海棠花落在无人的长椅上，整座城市还在沉眠，只有零星的烟火气在寂静里慢慢飘着，等着天边泛起第一缕浅金的晨光。", "w03": "- Imagine you have a set of nested Russian dolls: to reach the smallest doll, you open each larger doll one by one until you get to the tiniest one that cannot be opened further.\n- Recursion works just like this: a problem-solving function calls itself with a smaller, simpler version of the same problem, until it hits a base case that is easy to solve directly.\n- Once the base case is solved, the function works backward through all the smaller calls to combine results into the full answer, just like stacking the Russian dolls back together."}
